text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One night, while walking along the riverbank—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
—The match is one round only.
If you lose, you'll accept it gracefully, got it?

text_block_list.name: Man in Black A
text_block_list.text: Tch, the nerve of this brat talking like that to 'Angel-sama'...!

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
Stop it, sounds like someone's here.
...Don't tell me it's a dog?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing there was a horse girl in a Tracen Academy uniform,
facing off against a woman accompanied by a crowd of men in black suits...!
choice_data_list: What on earth is going on here?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm, that badge... Heh, well look at that.
You're with the academy, aren't ya.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it. You, Trainer, and you folks too.
What we're about to do is just a little game.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's just a regular game of Concentration.
Except my opponent happens to be her.

text_block_list.name: Man in Black B
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any idea how lucky you are?
Even VIPs have to wait in line to face Angel-sama—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Whoops...
Is that really something you wanna be blurting out to a passerby?

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
Heh, fair enough... You guys,
don't go causing trouble for honest folks.
This is 'our match.'

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Well. That's how it is, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Get out of here, quickly.
Step any further into this side and there'll be no turning back.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Look around, you can tell, right?
This isn't the world you live in.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
If you get it, disappear already.
Before you go scuffing up that spotless career of yours.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gazes of the lined-up men in black suits pierced through me.
...Perhaps they really are people from a dangerous underworld.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But standing before me is an academy horse girl.
She surely has goals she wants to achieve through running.
If so, as a trainer—
choice_data_list: I can't overlook this! I'll take your place!
I can't overlook this! I'll take your place!
Let's run away with everything we've got!
Let's run away with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
But standing before me is an academy horse girl.
She surely has goals she wants to achieve through running.
If so, as a trainer—
choice_data_list: I can't overlook this! I'll take your place!
I can't overlook this! I'll take your place!
Let's run away with everything we've got!
Let's run away with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Hey. Did you even hear what I just said?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Acting all cool when you're not even prepared to lose anything
just gets on my nerves.
choice_data_list: Protecting horse girls is what a trainer does!
Because protecting horse girls is what a trainer does!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Anyone who'd be such a bleeding heart for a horse girl they don't even know
is nothing but a complete fool.
choice_data_list: Even so, I'll take your place!
Even so, I'll take your place!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
............
You're completely killing the heat here.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...I'm heading back. Doesn't look like now is the time.

text_block_list.name: Man in Black C
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! What nonsense are you spouting!
We told you tonight was your only chance!

text_block_list.name: Midnight Angel
text_block_list.text:
...No, I don't mind.
Can't be helped once things cool down.
Besides, I want to see you when you're serious.

text_block_list.name: Man in Black B
text_block_list.text: ............If that is what Angel-sama wishes.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
My match gets interrupted, and I walk away with basically nothing.
What a completely fruitless night.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Though I did get to see something strange for the first time in a while.
...See ya, 'Trainer.'

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey. Don't pull on me!
Dammit... ngh!

text_block_list.name: Men in Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, where did they go?!
Search every last blade of grass!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... What the hell are you doing!
Right when I finally jumped into a cliffhanger situation...!
choice_data_list: If anything, right now is way more of a cliffhanger...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Right now...?
choice_data_list: I mean, if we get caught, it'll be bad, right?
I mean, wouldn't it be bad if we got caught?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Hahaha.
What do you know, you're the same kind after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*hoist...*)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I like it. Get caught, or shake 'em off.
Simple... and a gamble where you can put everything on the line.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hold on tight...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Goal. That wraps up our fun little getaway.
Alongside quite the ridiculous Trainer... Haha.
